title: The Foundational Architecture: Two Substances and the Discrete Degrees
summary: Opening with the creation-fall fragment (Adam's molding), the section unfolds the foundational dualism of Light and Darkness through their corresponding structures: the Two Trees as five-membered organisms of Life and Death; the triad of Goodness/Wisdom/Power at three discrete degrees; the Four Days and their counterfeit Nights; the Four Faces of Light against the Four Counterparts of Darkness; the Five Worlds of Darkness with their kings and metals; and the chain of Five Fathers as discrete degrees of divine accommodation. The arc moves from the bare opposition of two essences through the structural numbers (2, 3, 4, 5) by which Divine Truth and its counterfeits articulate themselves at every level of being.
organizing_principle: Numerical-doctrinal expansion from the basic dualism through the structural numbers (Two→Three→Four→Five→Five) that articulate the two substances at every degree. Each teaching introduces a more complete articulation of the same fundamental architecture.
